website.readmeExcerpt:
# Leader Target Sync

A tiny Dalamud plugin that repeatedly assists the party leader.

It is intended for follower clients: when enabled, it repeatedly sets your target to the current target of the party leader.

## Commands

```text
/ltsync on
/ltsync status
```

Useful options:

```text
/ltsync off
/ltsync interval 100
```

## Dalamud Repository

Add this custom plugin repository:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Naru6780/LeaderTargetSync/main/pluginmaster.json
```
